name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
summary: On the Wild Shore, the Bloodsail Buccaneers have raised a southern command post. Fleet Master Seahorn sends a trusted Blackwater Raider to seize their charts and orders, so the fleet can learn their plans.

sections.title: Raiding the Wild Shore
sections.body: Crazz’s praise has brought you to Fleet Master Seahorn’s notice. The Bloodsail Buccaneers have raised a southern command post on the Wild Shore. Seahorn sends you to strike their camp, cut down their swashbucklers, and seize their naval charts and written orders. The fleet needs those papers to learn what its rivals intend.

sections.title: Uncovering the Fleet's Scheme
sections.body: The Bloodsail charts and orders reveal the pirates’ plan. Seahorn concludes they have anchored close to the cape.

aliases: who gives the bloodsail buccaneers quest
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn assigns the raid from Booty Bay after Crazz praises your dedication.

faq.q: Where is the Bloodsail command post located?
faq.answer: The Bloodsail Buccaneers’ southern command camp lies along the Wild Shore, south of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What items are needed from the Bloodsail encampment?
faq.answer: Seahorn asks you to recover the Bloodsail Charts and written Bloodsail Orders to learn what the rival buccaneers intend.

faq.q: Why does Fleet Master Seahorn want their charts and orders?
aliases: what does seahorn want to know
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn wants the charts and orders to learn what the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning.
